lines.text: Open your eyes slowly. The light's cheap and it stays on.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: I'm Vantongeren. I run this hall. I was decanted here too, a long time ago, from a template like yours.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: I'm telling you that first because it's the only thing I can say that you'll believe.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

hints.text: {move} walk. Follow the line on the floor.

lines.text: You're a Wake. You came out of a vat this morning from a Sablier template that's older than the wall.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: You don't remember anything because there's nothing to remember; the template doesn't carry memories, only a shape.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: The shape is yours now. What you put in it is your business.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: Here's the part they make me say and the part I'd say anyway. For ninety days you're Sablier property under lease.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: You'll find that means less than it sounds like: you can go where you want, work for who you want, and nobody can sell you.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: After ninety days you're a person, with a name on the civic roll. Nothing gets you there sooner. The days count without you.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: The city's run by eight groups who'd each like you to think they're the only one that matters.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: Every one of them has left a card on my desk. I hand them out without preference.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: They all resent that and none of them can prove it. Take one, or don't. It's an introduction, not a contract.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: Work registers your signature sooner: a flat in your own name, and a side, if one will have you. It isn't personhood. It's a pen.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: When you're ready, walk to the door. There's a drone in the corridor that's been malfunctioning since Tuesday.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: Deal with it; consider it the first thing you've ever done.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: Then there's a terminal. Nurse Okafor will show you how to jack in. The door past it opens from the other side.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: A pistol on a cable by the door. Your hand takes it before you decide.
A drone turns in the corridor. It has seen you. Its shots can't kill.
If you die, you'll wake up here, or somewhere like here, with a bill. Sablier keeps a copy.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: It's not free and it's not perfect and you'll lose a little of yourself each time. But it's a copy.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: It's more than the city outside the wall gets.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: That's her on the hall channel. She watches every first one.
lines.speaker: okafor

lines.text: The drone stops. It had been trying since Tuesday.
You walk past it. It keeps trying.
The cable reels the pistol back to the wall.

hints.text: {target_next} picks the drone.  B walks past it
{fire} fires. Keep firing.  B walks past it

lines.text: Up you get. Vantongeren does the speech; I do the walking.
lines.speaker: okafor

lines.text: Stand close and jack in. Your body stays up here with me.
lines.speaker: okafor

hints.text: {program_1} casts Pick. Let it land.  B leaves

lines.text: Record first. Then I know what size.
lines.name: Wake Outfitter

lines.text: Read me the template line. I have to hear you say it.
lines.speaker: okafor

lines.text: No record in hand? I keep a copy. Read me the template line.
lines.speaker: okafor

lines.text: Hardline. Thought so. You took that hit like furniture.
lines.speaker: okafor

lines.text: Hardline. Thought so.
lines.speaker: okafor

lines.text: Ghost. You didn't make a sound on my floor. I mind that.
lines.speaker: okafor

lines.text: Ghost. Thought so.
lines.speaker: okafor

lines.text: Cantor. Don't hum in here. The vats pick it up.
lines.speaker: okafor

lines.text: Operator. You've been counting my staff since you came in.
lines.speaker: okafor

lines.text: And a name. The roll wants one.
lines.speaker: okafor

lines.text: Many names vanish from the lease rolls. Some leave the work; some disappear. The roll does not tell me which.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: Keep your own record.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: Issued: sidearm, 50 rounds, baton, two patches, two rations.
Issued: a {item:arm_kestrel_vest}. It's on you already.
Already fitted: a {item:imp_res_first_ear}. It knows one hymn, {hymn:hymn_steady}.
Issued: a {item:drn_kestrel_mule}. It carries the load. You give the orders.
200 chits. A card, on top: Vesper, the Tin Halo, Sodium Row.
Vesper, at the Tin Halo on Sodium Row, pays on time. Her card's the one I put on top.
lines.speaker: vantongeren

lines.text: Past the step it's Clinic Row. Our name's on it, not our protection. Walk like you know that.
lines.speaker: okafor

details.text: That drone would have hurt you less.
You wouldn't have needed the terminal. You carry your own.
The hum under the floor is louder for you. Some people will want to know what you hear.
You'd have sent something else down that corridor first.

late_card: The cards are still on the table. Nobody threw yours out.
